_comment: Fixed before any ENSO-rainfall statistic was computed (Stage F). Do not edit after seeing results without recording why.

notes: Stage F exploratory statistics use the discovery period (train + validation) only; the test period is not read by Stage F.

Split boundaries refer to the RAINFALL month. ENSO predictors at month t-L may come from an earlier split; that is allowed because predictors precede or overlap the target only through the documented 3-month ENSO window.
At the 2019-12 / 2020-01 boundary, RONI centred on 2019-12 averages Nov 2019-Jan 2020, i.e. includes one test-period SST month as a predictor (no target leakage).
CPC index construction uses base periods (RONI 1991-2020; ONI centred 30-year bases) that overlap later years; this is an index-construction dependence we cannot remove.

lag_convention: lag L pairs rainfall in month t+L with the ENSO value centred on month t (3-month window t-1..t+1). Positive L means rainfall follows the ENSO centre month. Lags 0 and 1 overlap the ENSO averaging window; lags >= 2 are strictly after it.
primary_family: RONI x {R1,R2,R3} x {DJF,MAM,JJA,SON} x lags {0,1,2,3} = 48 tests, Benjamini-Hochberg q within this family only

illustrative_family.status: illustrative prespecified test family; regions are data-derived, so not fully confirmatory

inference.surrogate: phase-randomised (Fourier) surrogates of the ENSO series over the needed months; rainfall held fixed; two-sided p = (1 + #|r_s| >= |r|) / (1 + N)
inference.bootstrap: moving-block bootstrap of season-years, block length 2 years, for 95% percentile CIs of r and slope
inference.ess: n_eff = n^2 / sum_ij rho_x(|t_i-t_j|) rho_y(|t_i-t_j|), ACFs from the full discovery-period monthly series, truncated at 24 months

rolling.status: exploratory visualisation only; overlapping windows are not independent tests

climatology.stage_f: calendar-month means and SDs over the discovery period 1998-01..2019-12
climatology.modelling: Stage H must re-estimate climatology from its own training data inside each fit
